## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/sortable`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`SortableDirective`](/api/sortable/SortableDirective) | Directive | Lets the user reorder a list's items by dragging them, or with Control+Shift and the arrow keys (Command+Shift on macOS), and announces each move. |
| [`SortableItemDirective`](/api/sortable/SortableItemDirective) | Directive | An item of a `monaSortable` list, given the array element it shows. |
| [`SortableGroupDirective`](/api/sortable/SortableGroupDirective) | Directive | Connects the sortable lists inside it, so an item can move from one to another: dragged, or with Control+Shift and the arrow keys that cross the lists, such as Left and Right between columns. |
| [`SortableHandleDirective`](/api/sortable/SortableHandleDirective) | Directive | Marks the part of a sortable item that starts a drag, such as a grip icon. |
| [`SortableMoveEvent`](/api/sortable/SortableMoveEvent) | Class | A move of an item, by pointer or keyboard, within a sortable list or into another list of its group. |
| [`moveItem`](/api/sortable/moveItem) | Function | A copy of `items` with the item at `from` moved to `to`, the index it has afterwards. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`SORTABLE_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`](/api/sortable/SORTABLE_DEFAULT_MESSAGES) | Constant |  |
| [`SortableMoveEventOptions`](/api/sortable/SortableMoveEventOptions) | Interface |  |
| [`SortableMoveKey`](/api/sortable/SortableMoveKey) | Type alias | The keys that move an item, held with Control and Shift (Command and Shift on macOS). |
| [`SortableOrientation`](/api/sortable/SortableOrientation) | Type alias | How a sortable list lays out its items: in a column (`vertical`), in a row (`horizontal`), or in rows that wrap (`mixed`), such as a grid of cards. |

**Related types:** [`MonaSortableMessages`](/api/i18n/MonaSortableMessages), [`PreventableEvent`](/api/common/PreventableEvent)
